title: Sefer Nameh: Relation du voyage de Nassiri Khosrau
version: Charles Schefer (ed. and trans.), Paris: Ernest Leroux, 1881. University of Toronto scan with separate French and Persian pagination.
lineage: Printed Persian edition of the medieval Safarnama with Schefer’s French translation. The arrival and hospital passages were examined in the Persian page images.

passages.locator: Persian p. 19 (PDF p. 504), last two lines; French p. 66 (PDF p. 136)
passages.note: The text dates the traveller’s arrival in Jerusalem to 5 Ramadan 438 AH. Schefer’s parenthetical conversion gives 16 March 1046, inconsistent with the 1047 year in other editions and modern scholarship.

passages.locator: Persian p. 21 (PDF p. 502), hospital passage; French p. 70 (PDF p. 140)
passages.quote: بیمارستانی نیکست و وقف بسیار دارد و خلق بسیار را دارو و شربت دهند و طبیبان باشند که از وقف مرسوم ستانند
passages.note: The text describes an endowed hospital in Jerusalem, says many people were given medicines and medicinal drinks, and specifies that physicians received stipends from the waqf. Schefer’s French translation places the Friday mosque at the eastern edge of the city and one of its walls beside Wadi Jahannam.
